'''Maremgi''', also known as '''Dineor''', is a [[Papuan language]] of [[Indonesia]]. It is spoken near the village of Bonggo, west of Jayapura, in a place also known as Maremgi.<ref>United States of America. Defense Mapping Agency. (1982). ''Gazetteer of Indonesia: Names Approved by the United States Board on Geographic Names''.</ref>
